Commentary.Commentary: As things stand, you'd back India to win this one. But this game is all about the start. If the Windies' top order can provide that, then they have the likes of Hetmyer, Powell and Holder in the middle who can capitalize on that. Let's see how the Indian bowlers fare on this surface. Join us on the other side of the break for all the action.

The Windies bowling was rather listless today. Yes, the Brabourne Stadium is batting friendly, but conceding so much anywhere is poor. The wickets weren't easy to come, but what the visitors didn't do effectively was plug the run flow. Allowed Rohit and Rayudu in particular to score too freely. All went for a lot of runs.

Needless to say, a mammoth total on the board for the Men in Blue. And it's all because of the local boy Sharma and Rayudu's 211-run stand. Electing to bat, Dhawan and Rohit got their side off to a flier. Dhawan departed and Kohli soon followed, but Rohit found an able ally in Rayudu and the two mixed caution with aggression perfectly. Rohit went on to cross 150, while Rayudu scored a fine century of his own. Dhoni, Jadeja and Jadhav added some vital, quick runs down the order and ensured India got to 377.

FOUR! Jadhav finishes the innings off in style. It's quite full, on the stumps and right in the slot for Jadhav. He gets under it and hammers it down the ground. Beats the man at long on and sends it across the boundary line. INDIA FINISH ON 377/5!
Low full toss outside off, hit down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Slower in pace, on a back of a length and it's away to the fence again. Jadeja stands inside the crease and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Just a single this time. Jadhav drives it through the covers and crosses over.
FOUR! Picks up the slower one and executes the shot to perfection. Short and outside off, Jadhav has all the time in the world to put this away. Carves it over point and beats the man in the deep.
Full delivery angling across, outside off, Jadeja smacks this down towards long off for a run.
Keemo Paul to bowl the final over of the innings.
FOUR! Shot. Full toss from Roach, around off, Jadhav stands his ground and lofts it over covers cleanly for a boundary. 11 runs coming in this over.
Short ball from Roach, Jadhav lets it be. The keeper fumbles and this allows the batsmen to take two byes.
Angling across, on a good length, Jadeja runs it down to third man for a single.
Ravindra Jadeja to bat next.

OUT! Dhoni is gone! A bit of an anti-climatic end to his stay in the middle. Still remains one short of that 10k mark in ODIs. Full and angling in on the pads, Dhoni flicks this aerially. Doesn't get the placement right and hands a straightforward catch to Chandrapaul Hemraj at short fine leg.

Dropped! But what an effort from Fabien Allen. Amazing try. Full and in the slot, Dhoni looks to go big downtown but only skies it to the cover region. Allen runs behind, the ball is coming over his shoulders and he dives forward. Gets his outstretched hands to the ball but can't hold on. Two runs are collected.
Slower short delivery wide outside off, Dhoni waits for it and then cuts it over cover-point. Sweeper cover moves to his left and cuts it off, keeping the batsmen down to two.
Kemar Roach returns to the attack.
Tossed up delivery outside off, driven to the left of wide long off by Jadhav. A brace is taken and the 350 is up for India.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short and outside off, Jadhav looks to cut but chops it off the under edge towards cover for one run.
Short again, punches it down to long on for a single.
Shorter and outside off, spinning away, Dhoni slaps it towards sweeper cover and comes back for the second.
Kedar Jadhav is the next man in.

OUT! Good work from Allen. Nicely done. Brings an end to a fine knock from the Indian no.4. Allen does well here. Seeing Rayudu give the charge, he shortens the length. The batsman can only force it to covers and he takes off. Allen moves to the ball, turns and scores a direct hit at his end. Rayudu starts walking but the umpire takes it upstairs, just to be sure. Replays show Rayudu is gone, but not before playing a superb innings.
A direct hit! Rayudu could be gone. He's already walking. Over to the TV umpire now, but seems he's gone.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Dhoni. Ends the over well. 14 from this one. A low full toss on the pads, Dhoni just flicks this past short fine leg, through backward square leg, and finds the boundary.
FOUR! Overpitched outside off, Dhoni squeezes it out square and lofts it over point. Nobody out there in the deep, so a boundary results.
The physio is out to have a look at Dhoni. The magic spray is out, should do the trick. Nothing too serious from the looks of it, MS should be fine to continue.

Hundred for Ambati Rayudu. His 3rd in this format. 80 balls is all it's taken him. The Brabourne Stadium is up on its feet to applaud the effort. Rayudu taps this length ball down in front of point and sets off. The fielder gets to the ball, has a shy at the striker's end but misses and hits Dhoni on the left forearm or wrist instead. The run is completed though.
Dhoni pushes this to long on as well and brings Ambati back on strike.
Full in line of the stumps, driven through mid on for a single. Rayudu moves to 99.

Dropped but it won't matter. Rayudu takes it on the full and slogs across the line. Rovman Powell from wide long on runs to his right but drops the catch, not that it would have mattered anyway. A couple of runs result.
No ball! And that means a Free Hit will be coming up. Paul looks to bowl the slower one but it slips out of his hands. Ends up bowling a beamer and the umpire signals the no ball.
Keemo Paul returns.
Ambati brings out the reverse paddle but can't get it past Hemraj at short third man. Single to end the over.
Keeps it short, keeps landing it well outside off, Dhoni slaps the cut to deep point and crosses over.
Room on offer, outside off, hit off the back foot through the covers for one this time.
Short and wide, cut towards sweeper cover off the back foot for a double.
Turning away, a bit slower through the air outside off, Rayudu gets low to sweep but it goes under his bat.
Flat, short and on off, Dhoni gives the charge and forces it down to long off for a single.
Fabian Allen is back on.
Full and just outside off, it's drilled but straight to the cover fielder.

SIX! That made a sweet sound off the bat. Monstrous hit from Ambati Rayudu as he moves into the 90s. Low full toss outside off, he moves across, gets under it properly and slogs it deep into the mid-wicket stands. Wow.
Moves inside the line and nudges it down to fine leg for one.
Full and attacks the stumps, Dhoni drives this straight back past the bowler. The umpire gets out of the way, avoids taking a serious blow and the batsmen take two.
Outside off on a good length, played to point for a single.
Back of a length coming in on off, Dhoni looks to play at it with the pull but it goes off the shoulder. A leg bye is taken.
Kemar Roach is back into the attack.
MSD drives this tossed up ball on off through mid-on and gets off the mark.

OUT! A bit loose from Rohit and that results in his downfall. RS goes after a wide and full ball outside off. It is too wide though as he cannot control his shot and ends up slicing this uppishly to the man at short third man. Hemraj, the fielder there, dives in front to take a good catch. West Indies get Rohit and that can save them 20-30 runs. The Windies will be more than happy to see the back of this dangerous shot-maker. The classy opener was on his way to his fourth ODI double century but falls short by 38 runs. Nevertheless, a brilliant knock from the Indian vice-captain comes to an end.
tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Short and a bit wide of off, cut straight to point.
Wide! Under pressure is Nurse, fires this too wide of off.
SIX! Whack! It's carnage time! Full and on middle, Rohit stays in his crease and launches it over the long on fence for a maximum.
Fires this one flat and full on his pads, Rayudu skips down the track and flicks it through mid-0wicket for a run.
Ashley Nurse is brought back into the attack.
FOUR! 16 runs off the over. The 200-run stand also comes up. A bit wide of off this on a length. Rohit flays at it and gets it racing through to the boundary at deep backward point.
Very full again on off, pushed to the cover region by the batsman.

FOUR! 7th 150-plus score for this champion in ODIs. Rohit comes inside the line of this short of a good length delivery around off. It is an off cutter again and Sharma pulls it over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
A low full toss is driven straight to the man at covers inside the ring.
Full on off, driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total.

SIX! Clobbered over mid-wicket. Ominous signs for the Windies. Rayudu picks this slower one on a length around off. He smacks it over the mid-wicket region for a biggie off the very first ball of the over.
Captain Holder brings himself back into the attack.
Shorter of a good length around off, shaping into the batsman. Rayudu does well to tap it into the point region to pick up a run.
Played to the point region by Rohit. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! That is unbelievable timing and placement. This is almost yorker length around off. Rohit just opens the face and touch drives this through covers for a magical boundary.
Very full on off, RS has played it towards mid-wicket.

SIX! BOOM! Six number 197. He is so very dangerous after he gets to the three-figure mark. A bit shorter of a good length this. Paul rolls his fingers over this but Rohit spots it well. Waits for it and pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a magnificent maximum.
Wide! Too wide of off, left alone and an extra conceded.
Length ball around off is pushes through the point region for a single.
The bowler loses his radar and dishes this very wide of off. Rohit goes after it but misses.
Ambati plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
FOUR! He has just swept a medium pacer for a majestic boundary. A length ball around off this, Rayudu goes down on one knee and sweeps this perfectly in the gap at deep square leg for a boundary.
Now drives this one through covers to exchange strike.
FOUR! Spectacular! Expecting a shorter in length ball as Rohit swivels and pulls it with great timing through square leg for the second consecutive boundary.
FOUR! Graceful, so beautiful for the eyes. A full delivery this outside off, Sharma nonchalantly drives this over the covers for a classy boundary.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Now a total of 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the end of the innings.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.

SIX! Boom! Simply magical! Dishes this one full again but misses his yorker this time. Sharma swings through the line and gets this over the long off fence for a magnificent biggie. RS now has the maximum ODI sixes for an Indian going past The Master, Sachin Tendulkar, to go on to 196 sixes.
Good bowling this by Paul, he fires this in the blockhole around off. Rayudu can just manage to dig it out into the cover region for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A bit shorter this outside off, punched through cover-point to get off strike.
On a good length around off, Sharma drives this to covers.
Keemo Paul comes back into the attack.
Tossed up around off,  Rohit drives this to long off for a run.
Driven towards the mid off region to pick up a single.

FOUR! Quality batting this. Rayudu gives himself a bit of room to this flighted ball on off, plays a lofted extra cover drive and places it perfectly for another boundary. He's looking really good now.
Rayudu dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
FOUR! Smacks the slog sweep. Rayudu kneels down and whacks this slog sweep over the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Comes down the track and defends this as he's not to the pitch of it. The fielder at point though throws it wildly over the bowler's head to concede an overthrow.
Driven through mid on by RS. One run added to the total.

FOUR! Wow, lovely shot. A length ball on off this, Sharma makes room towards the leg side, and then carves a punch through the covers to the boundary for four! Nurse's diving effort inside the circle just not good enough
A bit slower and flighted on off, driven through mid on to get a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Rohit has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Ambati plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.

SIX! BANG! Takes the new bowler on and does that well. A full ball on the stumps is deposited back over the bowler and over the fence for a superb maximum. Rayudu stayed back in this crease and blasts this one straight for a lovely biggie to put pressure on the spinner straight away.
Marlon Samuels comes into the attack.
A bit slow and shorter of full length, Ambati goes back and pushes this one through mid on for a single. Will retain strike.
Very full again attacking the stumps, stroked through mid off for a run.
Full again on middle and off, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted and very full around off, driven crisply to long off to get off strike.
Tossed up on off, driven through to mid off to get to his 10th ODI half century. He's looking good for a big one here.
A bit shorter this one on off, punched back to the bowler.
Ambati Rayudu out of the crease again, takes it on the full and hits to long on for a single.
Shortish just around off, looks to cut but mistimes it on the track beside him.
FOUR! Off the sweet spot of the bat and away to the fence. Back of a length on off, Rohit stands his ground, swings his bat and pulls it across the turf with power through square leg for a boundary.
Good length ball, but fraction straight in line, Ambati moves inside the line and nudges it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Angling back in on middle stump, worked in front of square leg. Single taken.
Back of a length delivery on off, Rohit rises and cuts, but finds Hetmyer positioned at point.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Slaps the pull down towards wide long on and rotates strike.
Comes forward to this flighted ball and eases it through to long off for a single.
Once again Rohit plays it towards the point fielder.
Touch short, outside off, cut straight to point.
Full and quick, on middle and leg, Ambati plants his front foot forward and works it through mid-wicket. Gets a single for doing so.
Behind a length, quite close to off, mistimes the punch back to the bowler.
Comes out of the crease again and steers this bumper behind point for one.
FOUR! Picking the gaps out well here. Rayudu gives the charge to Holder, it's short in length. He swings, pulls and gets it over mid-wicket. Nobody out there in the deep, so that will be a boundary.
Marginally behind a length, on off, Sharma helps the pull through square leg for a run.
On a length and outside off, run down to third man for a single.
FOUR! The 100-run stand comes up with this. This has been an excellent partnership between these two. Short ball, Rayudu pulls it through backward square leg and beats the man in the deep.
Jason Holder brings himself back into the attack.
Sharma defends this by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Drives this to long off and jogs across to the other end.
Short and wide, turning away, cut square through point for a run.

FOUR! There it is! Hundred for Rohit Sharma. His 21st in ODI cricket. Another exceptional knock from the Hitman. His hometown crowd stands up and applauds the effort. Short and wide, Rohit cuts this to point. The fielder there premeditates and moves to his left too quickly, and the ball goes from where he was orignially standing. It races away to the fence for a boundary. Now, the opener will look to accelerate and score a really big one.
Full on off, a bit quicker through the air, Rohit comes forward to defend.
Ambati once more steps out, lofts it over covers and brings Rohit, who in on 96, back on strike.
Knocks it down the ground, through to long on for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Comes half-forward and pushes it through mid off. Another run to the total.
Sliding across outside off, dabbed with an open face to point for one.
Picks it off his pads and works it away on the leg side for a single.

SIX! That's outta here! Rayudu's played the spinners very well since he's come on, continues to do the same now. Tossed up around off, he gives the charge to this again and smokes it over long on. The fielder at the rope can only watch it sail over him.

Drinks are on the field. India might have lost their skipper, but they have Rohit Sharma still in the middle and he's looking in fine touch. He's joined hands with Ambati Rayudu and the two are cruising along well here, with the opener close to another ODI ton. Windies need a wicket and fast, otherwise this partnership will threaten to score really big.
Full and landed outside off, driven straight to the cover fielder.
Rayudu shimmies down the track, gets close to the pitch and offers a punchy-drive to wide long off for a single.
Drifting in on middle and leg, flicked through the mid-wicket area for one run. Moves to 94 with that.
FOUR! The Mumbai lad is putting on a show for the home crowd. Short and wide, Sharma goes back and cuts it through point. In the gap perfectly, there's no stopping that. Mrs. Sharma loves that.
Tossed right up there once more, pushed to the same area again.
Spinning away from a fuller length, pushed towards short extra cover.
Takes a step out of the crease and works it towards mid-wicket.
Quicker through the air on the off stick, forced on the off side. Dot ball.
Nurse is too short once more, has to correct that. Sharma cuts it to deep point and takes a single.

FOUR! Finds the gap again. Had power, placement and precision. Short, flat and turning in from outside off, Rohit stays leg side again and punches it powerfully past the diving cover fielder, beating the man in the deep.
FOUR! Short, flat and wide, darted outside off. Rohit backs away and places the cut behind point to send it across the boundary line.
Looped up on off stump, blocked with the full face of the bat.
Allen slows this up as he bowls it full on off, Rayudu blocks by coming on the front foot.
Arm ball sliding in on middle, Rohit waits for it before turning it in front of square leg. Single to the total.
Flat, short and quick on off, hangs inside the crease and whips it to wide long on. Jogs across to the other end.
FOUR! Lovely shot from Rayudu. He was expecting the ball to be tossed up. So he jumped out of the crease, got close to the pitch and smacked it over covers for a boundary.
Makes good use of the feet, steps out and taps it down in front of cover.
Stays on the back foot and pushes it away to the cover area.
Fabian Allen is into the bowling attack.
Uses the depth of the crease to go back and turn it on the leg side.
Looped up off break outside off, Rayudu is on the front foot as he pushes it just wide of the cover fielder. Crosses over to get off strike.
Turning in from around off, short again, punched off the back foot through mid on for one more.
Comes forward to this tossed up ball and knocks it down to long on for a run.
Full and straight, Rayudu plays it back to the bowler.
Flat, short and wide outside off, cut square through point for one.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single. 15 runs off the over. A big one for India. This is the most expensive over of the innings so far.
FOUR! Put away. Rovman is too straight with his line. Rohit can just stay on the back foot and pull it behind square leg to find the fence.
A bit of room outside off, Rayudu throws his bat at it and finds sweeper cover as he takes a single.
Pushes this down to long on and gets to the other end.
FOUR! Deft. Nicely done by the opener. Length delivery just outside off, Sharma waits for it, opens the face slightly and runs it through the vacant slip cordon for another boundary.
FOUR! Back of a length on off, Rohit moves across, gets inside the line and just helps the pull through backward square leg for a boundary.

Not out. Nurse fires this one wide of the stumps and draws Rayudu forward, he misses the ball and the keeper whips the bails off in a flash. However, Ambati is quick to drag his foot back inside the crease. No damage done.
A stumping appeal has been referred upstairs. The batsman in question is Ambati Rayudu.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
A bit shorter again and outside off, cut through point for a brace.
Wide! Way down the leg side. Wide given.
Beaten! A bit quicker and outside off, Rohit looks to play at it initially and then at the last moment tries to run it fine onto the off side with an open bat face but misses the ball completely.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Much fuller and on Rayudu's pads. The right-hander flicks this well but straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Marginally shorter of a good length around off, punches it straight to the man at covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short and wide of off, Sharma plays the square cut. One run added to the total.
Fuller ball on middle and off, driven to mid-wicket.
A length ball on off shaping into the batsman, Rayudu taps this to the mid-wicket fielder.
Flighted ball on off, driven to mid off. The batsmen don't risk a single.
Similar ball this, Sharma rocks back and punches this through cover-point to get to the other end.
Punched off the back foot through point. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Very full and fast just outside off, Rayudu opens the bat face and lets the ball take the outer bottom edge and fly through fine of the short third man fielder for a boundary.
Flighted and slower ball on middle and leg, tucked away into the mid-wicket region to get off strike.
Tossed up ball a bit wide of off, Rayudu pushes it through the cover-point region to pick up a single.
Ashley Nurse comes back to roll his arm over.
Length ball attacking the stumps, blocked out onto the leg side by Sharma.
Full ball on off is driven to long off to add a run to the total.
Short and wide of off again, Rohit this time plays it to backward point to jog across to the other end.
Similar ball this, tapped into the point region to get a single.
Attacking the corridor outside off, Rayudu lunges forward in a solid defense.
A bit on the shorter side outside off, Sharma punches it through point to get off strike.
Wide outside off stump, Rayudu leaves it alone.
The ball has been square driven by the right-hander. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR! Brilliantly timed through the point region for a beautiful boundary. It is short and wide of off, Rohit uses the pace and just times it past the left of the point fielder for a cracking boundary.
Length ball on off, it has taken the inside edge and thudded into Rohit's pads. No run there.

FOUR! Pulled for a lovely boundary. 37th half century for the Indian vice-captain. Paul bangs it in short looking to surprise the batsman. Rohit though is well set to put this away and he pulls this confidently through mid-wicket for a boundary and brings up another fifty. Needs to carry on though.
Starts the new over with another off cuter, short outside off. Rohit opens the face of his bat and steers it through the point region for a brace.
A bit shorter in length around off allowing the batsman to play it through the point region for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fuller in length around off, driven to mid off and a quick single stolen.
Almost a mix-up, but no damage done. Rayudu opens his bat face to run this length ball through to third man, the fielder at point though does well to stop it and stop the run as well.
Lands this fuller and on off, Sharma leans ahead to stroke it through mid on for a single.
Starts well with a good length ball in the corridor around off, Sharma stays in his crease and keeps it out.
Rovman Powell comes into the attack.
Short ball this time to end the over, Rayudu stands tall and taps it onto the off side, no run on offer though.
Rolls his fingers over this and keeps it wide of off, Rohit reaches out to it and plays it to deep point for a single.
Full and around off, Rohit comes forward in a solid defense.
Very full on off, almost a yorker. Well dug out by the Indian vice-captain.
Wider of off but this time Rohit tries to play a cut, gets a bottom edge onto the ground.
A length ball just outside off, Sharma watchfully leaves it and sees it through into the mitts of Hope.
This time he waits that bit longer to steer it through to third man to retain strike.
On a good length and outside off, played to the fielder at point.
Dishes this one on a good length but wide of off, Rohit is happy to shoulder arms.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A bit shorter of a good length, tapped through point for a single.
Short ball in line of the stumps, Sharma plays the pull shot to deep square leg. One run added to the total.
FOUR! A cracking cover drive brings up the first boundary for Rayudu. A full ball outside off, Ambati flays at it and strokes the drive through covers for a lovely confidence-boosting boundary.
A bit shorter and marginally outside off, Rayudu looks to push at it but misses.
Some chin music by Paul, Ambati lets that bouncer through to the wicket-keeper.
The ball is too wide on the off side for Rayudu to make any contact.
Very short and wide outside off. Left alone.
Lovely yorker this, an inside edge at the last moment has saved Ambati Rayudu. Ambati seemed surprised by this one as he brings his bat down at the last moment to dig this one out.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Sharma does well to not bother himself with it.
Back of a length on the hips, Rayudu rises on his toes and works it down on the leg side for a single. He's off the mark.
Ambati Rayudu is the next batsman in.

OUT! This is a big wicket for Windies. The in-form skipper Virat Kohli has been dismissed early. He fails to equal Kumar Sangakkara's record of scoring four consecutive ODI centuries. Excellent delivery. Roach lands it just outside off on a good length, a hint of away movement as Kohli comes half-forward to block. It takes the edge and Shai Hope behind takes a simple catch. This will also provide a psychological boost to the visitors. Also, this is Kohli's lowest score in ODIs in 2018.
A lot of width offered outside off, Sharma cuts but gets it off the outer half down to third man. One run to the total.
Extremely full and quite wide outside off, Virat pushes it away towards covers. A quick single is taken. The 100 comes up for India with this.
Short and wide outside off, cut a bit square through cover-point for a single.

On the fuller side of things, outside off, Kohli drives it through the covers. Sweeper cover moves to his right, slides to stop it. Does so but there's a small doubt that his leg might have touched the rope in doing so. The umpire checks it upstairs and replays show Kieran Powell has done well. Two runs taken.
Short and wide outside off, cuts this behind point for a run.
Good length ball in the channel outside off, tempts Sharma but he doesn't go for it. Lets it be.
Too straight in line, on a length, easily clipped down to fine leg for one.
Places this square through point and gets to the other end.
Play and a miss! Short and wide outside off, Sharma looks to cut but fails to connect.

Drinks. A good brisk start by India after electing to bat first. They would have been happier to reach here without the loss of their left-handed opener. Captain Kohli though has joined Rohit out there in the middle and both these senior campaigners will look to build a strong partnership and a steady base for some quick acceleration at a later stage. Windies, on the flip side, will be eager to see the back of the century maker - Virat Kohli. Also, they will be more than happy to get the wicket of the dangerous Rohit Sharma as early as possible. A well set Rohit can be as dangerous, if not more.
Rohit plays this to the point region. They pick up a single.
Short ball again, seems like a plan against the Indian skipper. Kohli pulls it to deep fine leg for a single.

Beaten in pace. Shorter in length around off. Kohli tries to turn it away into the leg side but gets beaten as the ball is a bit slow in reaching him. It goes between his bat and body to the keeper behind.
Fuller ball around off, it's driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total.
Nonchalantly strokes this through covers but straight to the man at sweeper cover for just a run.
FOUR! Classic Kohli. A full and wide ball outside off is smashed through covers by the Indian captain. Seems like in this series, he will drive this through the covers with his eyes closed.
Kemar Roach is back into the attack.
A bit shorter of a good length around off, tapped into the point region for a single to retain strike.

FOUR! Cannot bowl such deliveries to such a player! He will punish you all day long. Short and angling into Virat. The Indian skipper rocks back, swivels and pulls it fine into the leg side. It is fine enough to beat the fielder at fine leg. Kohli gets his first boundary and the Indian rockstar is up and running.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fuller length ball on off, smashed back straight by Kohli. Paul gets his hand to it and stops the batsman from taking a run.
Taps this to point to get off strike.

FOUR! Too good! Ramp shot played to perfection. A bouncer tried by Paul, well directed but Rohit is too good a player to get surprised by this one, at this pace. Rohit leans back and ramps this over the keeper's head for a lovely boundary.
Wants a quick run but a loud NO from Rohit. Good call. Kohli taps this in front of point and wants the run, rightly sent back.
Shaping back in on middle and leg, worked in front of square leg this time. Another single.
Banged in short, Virat doesn't exactly get a proper hold of the pull shot. Places it through square leg for a single. He's off the mark.
Full in length, on the fifth stump line, Kohli presses forward and meets it with the full face.
Length delivery closer to off, Kohli stands in his crease and blocks it down on the off side.
Full and wide outside off, Rohit reaches out for it and drives it through the gap in the covers for a single.
Back of a length outside off, and zipping off the surface and into Kohli's gut. Shapes up to defend but misses his shot to get rapped on the thigh pad.
Wide! The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Virat Kohli walks in to the middle.

OUT! West Indies draw first blood, totally against the run of play! Short ball again asking to be whacked. Dhawan does exactly that, gets a good piece on it but fails in finding the gap. The ball goes straight to short mid-wicket where Kieran Powell takes a good sharp catch. It came at a good pace to him. Guess what, Paul gives Dhawan a send off by doing his trademark celebration. Shikhar smirks. In other news, Dhawan gets past the 30-run mark but fails to make it big again.
A bit shorter around off this, tapped into the point region off the back foot.
Defended off the front foot by the southpaw presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Wonderfully pulled! Banged in short from around the wicket shaping into the southpaw. Dhawan rocks back and pulls this strongly through mid-wicket for a emphatic boundary.
Four Byes! Bouncer attempted but ill-directed. Too short and way down the leg side. The diving keeper is not able to stop it from going behind to the boundary.
Keemo Paul replaces Ashley Nurse.
FOUR! Smashed! You cannot give this kind of room to classy batsmen like these. A short and wide ball outside off is cut through the point region by Rohit with utmost ease. Super shot.
A bit shorter this and wide of off, Dhawan cuts it fiercely through cover-point but straight to the fielder at the fence, they take a single.
Dhawan has played it to the point region.
A good length ball angling into Shikhar from around the wicket. Dhawan blocks it off the back foot.
Fuller on off, driven through covers for a single.
Full length ball on off, Rohit lunges forward to defend it with a straight bat right under his eyes.
Wide! Too wide of off this, extra conceded.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Now four fielders will be allowed outside the circle till the 40th over.
Played to the point region by the southpaw.
Full and straight attacking the stumps, Rohit flicks it to square leg for a single.
Strays on the pads of Shikhar, the southpaw paddle sweeps it fine onto the keeper's pads and into the leg side for a run.
Similar ball but this time Rohit opens his bat face to run it through the backward point region to get a single.
A bit shorter and wide of off, cut to the fielder at point.
Drags his length back a bit and fires this one on middle and leg, Rohit looks to turn this into the leg side but gets a leading edge to cover-point.
Fractionally shorter of a good length around off, the southpaw has played it to the point region.
Shorter and wider of off again, Rohit plays it through cover-point off the back foot to get off strike.
Keeps this outside off, Rohit shoulders arms.
A bit shorter and straighter attacking the stumps, tapped into the point region.
Wide! Short and wide of off, Rohit is content in letting these ones go behind. Too wide though, wide given.
Dishes this one fuller and wide of off. Rohit is skeptical to go after it and decides to watchfully let it be.
Very wide of off, lucky for Holder that wasn't given as a wide. Rohit leaves it.
Jason Holder has swapped ends.

FOUR! Flighted ball around off, a bit more air given by Nurse. Dhawan checks his drive through covers. The ball flies over the fielders in the ring and Shikhar gets a second boundary on consecutive balls.
FOUR! Handsome cut! A bit quicker, shorter and fractionally wide of off. Shikhar Dhawan rocks back to cut it through point for a boundary.
Tossed up around off, Rohit leans forward to stroke it through mid on for a single.
Defended off the back foot by Rohit.
Similar ball and a similar punch to the same fielder at covers.
A bit short around off stump, Rohit punches it to covers.
Spin introduced quite early as Ashley Nurse comes into the attack.
Wide of the stumps, Dhawan decides to let it go behind.
Short ball on middle and off, Rohit pulls it to deep square leg and takes a run.
A bit fuller on off, pushes into the cover region for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A full ball this angling into the stumps, defended from the front foot. The ball drops at his feet and takes off for a single, but is sent back by Rohit.

SIX! Wow! That is majestic! Again Roach strays on his pads and pays the price. From around the wicket he fires this full ball on Dhawan's pads. The southpaw looks in too good a nick to let this one go. He flicks this nonchalantly over the mid-wicket region for a massive biggie.
Driven through mid off by Shikhar. They pick up a single.
Dhawan guides this short of a length ball through point to get a brace.
Lovely shot this but straight to the cover fielder. Dhawan hits this from the middle but did not find the gap as per his liking.
Marginally shorter of a good length, tapped to point by the southpaw.
Short and wide of off, cut straight to point. Dhawan misses out on this scoring opportunity.

SIX! Smack! The southpaw in action now. Length ball angled into his pads, Shikhar Dhawan stays in his crease and smacks this uppish flick over the deep square leg fence for a brilliant maximum. Second one in two overs.
Length ball on off, blocked off the front foot.

SIX! WHACK! A 99-meter biggie from Rohit. On a good length this around off, not that bad a ball. But Rohit Sharma still puts it away. The right-hander smashes this one over the mid-wicket boundary for the first maximum of the match. Lovely shot this, typical RS.
Edged and short of first slip. Marginally shorter of a good length around off. Rohit pushes at it from the crease. The ball takes the outside edge but falls way short of first slip.

A bit uppish this and a bit of a misfield from the Windies captain. Roach dishes this one full on middle and leg. Dhawan flicks this uppishly through mid-wicket. Holder there fumbles a bit allowing the batsmen to run through for a single.
Full on off, driven crisply through covers to get a brace.
Roach from around the wicket fires this on a good length around off, shaping into the southpaw. Shikhar defends off the front foot.
On a good length and wide of off again but not very far. Rohit leaves it alone.
Wide! Too wide of off this, an extra conceded.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the right-hander.
Fuller and straighter from Jason, Shikhar tries to flick it but gets an inside edge onto the pads into the square leg region. The batsmen take a single.
Dhawan has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Beauty! That's much better from Holder. He keeps it full around off, Shikhar is stuck in the crease as he looks to drive it straight back without much foot movement. The ball lands and nips away a bit beating Shikhar's tentative push. Brilliant bowling, this.
Fractionally shorter of a good length around off, Rohit taps it very late toward third man to get off strike.
Good finish by Kemar as he lands this on a good length just around off, Shikhar defends by coming forward.
Defended off the front foot by the southpaw presenting the full face of the bat.
Played to the point region by the batsman.

FOUR! That's silky smooth from the elegant southpaw. These kind of shots get your confidence sky high. Roach keeps it full and marginally outside off, looking to get some movement. Dhawan leans forward and times this drive wonderfully through the cover region.
On a good length in the corridor around the off pole. The southpaw comes forward to defend it solidly.
Dishes this in from around the wicket, on a good length angling into Dhawan. Shikhar blocks it off from within the crease.
The Indian opener is happy to be patient and watchfully leaves this ball wide of off.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for Sharma.
Better from Holder as he keeps this on a good length around middle and off. Similar ball which got Rohit in the last game. The right-hander defends it off the front foot.
Again lands this quite wide of off, Rohit happy to let it go.
On a good length and a bit wide of off, Sharma shoulders arms.
FOUR! Classic Rohit Sharma. Watta shot! A wide and full floating delivery to start off by the Windies captain, Sharma takes full toll by timing it through cover-point for a cracking boundary.
Shikhar has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
It's been driven superbly to the covers.
Short and wide of off, cut straight to cover-point.

Big appeal for an LBW, turned down. Very full ball on middle and off, from over the wicket and angling into the batsman, the southpaw looks to flick it into the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads, which saves him.
Straighter and a bit shorter of a good length angling into Rohit, Sharma tucks it into the square leg region to get off strike.

FOUR! Loosener to start from Roach, a very rusty start this. Lands this one short and wide of off. Rohit reaches out for it and opens the bat face. The ball flies over the point region for a boundary on the very first ball. India and Rohit are off the mark.

We are all set to get play underway as the umpires and the West Indian players are seen making their way out to the middle. The Indian opening pair of  Rohit Sharma and Shikar Dhawan also stride out to the center with the former taking strike. Kemar Roach to start proceedings for the Windies.

Ambati Rayudu is having a chat with feels that it has been a very competitive series uptil now. Reckons that the wicket looks good and the side that ACTUALLY bowls well today will win. On his batting, he feels that he is in good nick but wants to convert his starts into big knocks. Wants to play to the merit of the ball and keep himself busy. On the previous game, he stresses that India were in control till he and Pant were batting but unfortunately both got out very quickly. But is not too perturbed and wants the Indian batsmen to bat as they normally do. Hopes to get a big score today.

Windies captain, Jason Holder, says that he is happy to bowl first as it is a fresh wicket and not much international cricket has been played here. Hopes his bowlers make use of that and strike early. Does not want to look too much into the series and wants to win today first. Informs that Keemo Paul comes in for Obed McCoy.

Indian skipper, Virat Kohli, reckons that the surface looks nice and hard and he has heard that there is not much dew here around the evening. Also feels that there could be some movement later on. Feels that this is a high-scoring ground and informs that his side has got more batting depth today. Wants to give his bowlers some extra rest, hence the decision to bat first. On the Windies, Virat agrees that they are side which cannot be taken lightly at all as they play hard cricket. But feels that losing is also a part of the journey and how a team bounces back from a loss is a true indication of its character. On the team news, Kohli informs that Kedar Jadhav and Ravindra Jadeja come in for Rishabh Pant and Yuzvendra Chahal.
TOSS - Time for the spin of the coin. Kohli flips it but Holder calls incorrectly. INDIA WILL BAT FIRST.

PITCH REPORT - Sunil Gavaskar reckons that the surface looks good for batting, devoid of grass. feels that the spinners will get a little bit of grip but it will be beautiful for batting. Observes that the outfield is lush green and the ball will travel. Adds that India might want to chase here, as dew is a possibility.

WEATHER REPORT - Well, it normally does not rain in Mumbai beyond September but after what has happened in the last 2 years, wherein we have witnessed rainfall even in October and November, might keep fingers crossed anyway. The forecast says bright and sunny and gut feeling is it will stay that way. However, not many expected rain last night in Oman and Dubai. So... hope that mother nature gives preference to cricket.

It is game time! Not many would have expected this but it is actually 1-1 after 3 completed ODIs. Barring the first match with the ball, the Windies have stretched the hosts in all the games. However, India is a unit which rarely buckles under pressure. Will we see a bounceback today? Hello and a warm welcome to the fourth ODI between India and Windies at the Brabourne Stadium, Mumbai.
